\label{lemma-locally-projective}
Let $X$ be a scheme.
Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal{O}_X$-module.
The following are equivalent
\begin{enumerate}
\item $\mathcal{F}$ is locally projective, and
\item there exists an affine open covering $X = \bigcup U_i$
such that the $\mathcal{O}_X(U_i)$-module
$\mathcal{F}(U_i)$ is projective for every $i$.
\end{enumerate}
In particular, if $X = \Spec(A)$ and $\mathcal{F} = \widetilde{M}$
then $\mathcal{F}$ is locally projective if and only if $M$ is a projective
$A$-module.
stage_b_review_note: Pinned lemma 2729 equates locally projective quasi-coherent F with existence of an affine cover on which module sections are projective, and adds the affine Spec A equivalence with projective M. Both equivalences are included.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-locally-projective-pullback}
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a morphism of schemes.
Let $\mathcal{G}$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal{O}_Y$-module.
If $\mathcal{G}$ is locally projective on $Y$, then $f^*\mathcal{G}$
is locally projective on $X$.
stage_b_review_note: Pinned lemma 2767 says pullback f*G of locally projective quasi-coherent G along ANY scheme morphism remains locally projective; no flatness of f is required.
